name: Frightening Infusion
body:
Discipline psychometabolism; Level dread 6

MANIFEST

Display Auditory and mental
Manifesting Time 1 round

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/2 levels
Saving Throw see below; Power Resistance yes

Power Points 11

DESCRIPTION

You are empowered with terror incarnate. When you strike a creature with a melee, ranged, or psionic attack, the creature must also make a Will save or become frightened for 2d6 rounds and if they make their save they are still shaken for 1d4 rounds.
